caller_must_enforce: Explicit authorization before any live command
Single child owner without another reaper
Whole-deployment deadline across startup, preflight and inference
Signal handling at the eventual launcher entry point
Require both acceptable worker outcome and cleanup outcome
limitations: Process group control is not an OS sandbox
Cleanup has an additional grace and reap interval
Escaped process groups and remote in-flight requests are not covered
Cloud instance billing is never stopped by this component
